senses.gloss:
ITA-6.2.6.16 lekhanam लेखनम्
Drying and sloughing
A therapeutic action which dries and sheds tissues or impurities from the body.

ITA-9.5.26 lekhana-āścyotanam लेखन-आश्च्योतनम्
Instillation of eye drops for curetting effect
The instillation of liquid medications in the eye for curetting effect.

ITA-9.6.66 lekhanakarma लेखनकर्म
Scraping
The procedure of removing hard, raised excess tissue by scraping or curettage.

ITA-9.6.135 lekhanakarma लेखनकर्म
Therapeutic scraping
Therapeutic scraping procedure for wound management.

ITA-9.5.18 lekhanapuṭapākaḥ लेखनपुटपाकः
Retention of heat extract bolus with curetting effect
A therapeutic procedure in which an herbal extract expressed from indirectly heated bolus is retained over the eyes for a stipulated period for curetting effect.

ITA-9.5.22 lekhanasekaḥ लेखनसेकः
Continuous streaming of liquid medicines over the eyes for curetting effect
A procedure involving gentle pouring of a thin stream of medicated solution over the closed eyelids for a stipulated period for curetting effect.

ITA-9.5.28 lekhanāñjanam लेखनाञ्जनम्
Collyrium with curetting effect
A type of collyrium or añjanam with curetting effect.

ITA-5.76.178 lekhanāñjana-atiyogaḥ लेखनाञ्जन-अतियोगः
Condition due to excessive application of scraping collyrium
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: distortion of eyes or vision; hardness in eyes; discoloration of eyes; flabbiness; excessive dryness of eyes; excessive lacrimation.

ITA-5.76.176 lekhanāñjana-apacāraḥ लेखनाञ्जन-अपचारः
Condition due to improper application of scraping collyrium

ITA-5.76.177 lekhanāñjana-ayogaḥ लेखनाञ्जन-अयोगः
Condition due to suboptimal application of scraping collyrium

ITA-5.76.213 lekhanātiyogaḥ लेखनातियोगः
Doncition due to excessive scraping in eye diseases
A condition characterized by some or all the following signs and symptoms: the eyelids remaining everted; eyelashes becoming distorted; pain; profuse discharge.

ITA-5.76.214 lekhanāyogaḥ लेखनायोगः
Condition due to inadequate scraping in eye diseases
A condition characterized a thick bloody discharge from the eye wound produced by the instrument; redness/congestion; oedema; excessive discharge; errors of refraction/partial blindness; failure of condition to improve; brownish discoloration of eyelid; heaviness; fixedness of eyelid; itching of eyelid; flickering of eyelids; sticky discharge; severe inflammation of eye.

ITA-9.5.9 lekhyarogaḥ लेख्यरोगः
Eye disorders for curetting
Eye diseases in which the surgical procedure of curetting or scraping is indicated.
